pages.title: Brewing Station
pages.text: A 12-slot brewing pot with a 1000 mB fluid tank, used for alchemy, witch merging and potion-stage recipes. The full recipe list is visible in JEI under Alchemy Pot.

$(bold)How to operate$()$(br)Right-click with a fluid container to fill or drain the tank. Right-click with an item to insert it (containers like buckets are handled). Right-click with an empty hand to take back the last item; sneak to empty everything.$(br2)A hint overlay lists the ingredients the current brew accepts. The pot ticks its recipe on the server until the timed brew completes.
